title: Why Dozens Of Volcanoes Are Erupting Right Now
hook: Somewhere on Earth, a volcano is almost always erupting right now.
closing: Something, somewhere, is always on fire under your feet.
question: Did you know one was erupting today?

segments.say: Right now, about 45 volcanoes around the world are actively erupting.
About 75 percent of all active volcanoes sit along one line, the Pacific Ring of Fire.
Just 16 of those volcanoes are rated dangerous enough to earn a spot on the official watch list.
